name: EPE Formetto – PDF Attachments for Contact Forms
author: epetechsolutions

sections.description:
EPE Formetto – PDF Attachments for Contact Forms automatically generates a PDF file from submitted form data and attaches it to the Contact Form 7 email.

This plugin is designed to be simple, secure, and reliable, focusing on one task only: turning form submissions into clean, readable PDF documents.

Key features:

  • Generate a PDF when a Contact Form 7 form is submitted
  • Attach the generated PDF to the Contact Form 7 email
  • Select which form should generate PDFs
  • View, open, and delete recent PDFs from the WordPress admin
  • Optional watermark support
  • Secure storage inside the WordPress uploads directory

Important note:
Contact Form 7 is a third-party plugin.
This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Contact Form 7 project.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure Contact Form 7 is installed and activated.
  4. Go to Settings → EPE Formetto.
  5. Select the Contact Form 7 form that should generate PDFs.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Contact Form 7?

Yes. Contact Form 7 must be installed and active.

Where are the generated PDFs stored?

PDFs are stored in the WordPress uploads directory inside a protected subfolder created by the plugin.

Can I choose which form generates PDFs?

Yes. Only the form selected in the plugin settings will generate PDFs.

Does this plugin lock features behind a license?

No. All functionality included in this plugin is fully available without license checks.
